name: Keeping Vows
overview: Scripture clearly teaches the importance of faithfully fulfilling vows made to the Lord, emphasizing that breaking such promises is considered sin and profaning God's name. Believers are called to diligently pay their vows without delay, recognizing that God will require their fulfillment. The Psalms express a heart committed to daily performing and offering vows as acts of worship and thanksgiving, underscoring the seriousness and devotion involved in keeping one's word to God.
